flags.message: context.json carries distribution_count 2, which the relist cut reads as one relist. On this docket the first distribution (May 12 for the May 28 conference) was superseded by a response request on May 18 before any conference, and the second (July 1 for September 28) is the first distribution of the briefed petition. The Court has not yet conferenced the case, so the frozen band's relist component overstates the trajectory. I anchored on the elevated band as instructed and noted the discount in reasoning.md.
